style: Cinematic fine-art photograph, photorealistic, chiaroscuro with one soft key light from the upper right, deep ink-violet near-black background, rich crimson red accents, porcelain white highlights, small touches of natural green, medium format camera, 80mm lens, tack-sharp subject, subtle film grain, quiet museum-quality mood. The subject sits in the right half of the frame; the left half and the bottom-left corner fall off into smooth dark shadow, leaving generous empty negative space for a headline. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no hands, no human faces.

hero-home.prompt: A noble golden retriever and an elegant silver tabby cat sitting close together on a dark slate ledge, both looking calmly toward the viewer with bright healthy eyes and glossy coats, rim light tracing the edges of their fur; beside them on the slate a small white porcelain bowl, a halved pomegranate with glistening crimson seeds and a sprig of fresh sage. Fine-art pet portrait staged like a Dutch Golden Age painting, tack-sharp eyes.

hero-home-m.prompt: Vertical composition. A noble golden retriever and an elegant silver tabby cat sitting close together on a dark slate ledge, both looking calmly toward the viewer with bright healthy eyes and glossy coats, rim light tracing the edges of their fur, a small white porcelain bowl and a halved pomegranate with crimson seeds beside them. Fine-art pet portrait, tack-sharp eyes. The two animals fill the upper half of the frame; the lower half is smooth deep shadow for a headline.

hero-corsi.prompt: A long row of round glass petri dishes receding diagonally across a dark laboratory bench, each dish holding a different specimen: pomegranate seeds, a purple sage leaf, crimson and violet bacterial colonies on agar, red currants, a slice of beetroot with concentric rings, a few dry pet kibbles, a chamomile flower; a narrow raking beam of light makes the glass rims glow.

hero-contatti.prompt: Still life on dark ink-violet paper: a black fountain pen resting on a cream envelope sealed with crimson wax, beside it a white porcelain cup of ruby red hibiscus infusion with a thin wisp of steam and a small sprig of purple basil.

lens-nutrizione-umana.prompt: A white porcelain plate on dark stone holding a precise specimen-like arrangement of whole foods: a halved pomegranate with glistening crimson seeds, thin beetroot slices showing concentric rings, a red cabbage cross-section revealing deep violet veins, a halved fig, blueberries and a sprig of purple basil, seen from a low three-quarter angle.

lens-microbiota.prompt: A round glass petri dish backlit on a dark surface: translucent agar with bacterial colonies grown in organic branching and dotted patterns in crimson red, deep violet and soft pink like a delicate abstract painting, a thin rim of light on the glass edge; scientific macro photography with an art-gallery sensibility.

lens-fitoterapia.prompt: An apothecary still life on a dark wooden table: a white porcelain mortar and pestle, small amber glass dropper bottles without labels, fresh echinacea flowers with magenta petals, purple sage, lavender sprigs, a hawthorn branch with small red berries, chamomile heads and a few pale dried roots.

lens-nutrizione-animale.prompt: A calm golden retriever dog and a tabby cat resting side by side on dark velvet, rim light outlining their fur, serene expressions, a small white porcelain bowl nearby; fine-art pet portrait, tack-sharp eyes.

lens-comunicazione.prompt: Two white porcelain cups of ruby red hibiscus infusion facing each other on a dark table as if two people were in conversation, a thin wisp of steam rising between them, an open notebook with blank pages and a black fountain pen beside them.
